mostWorthwhile.text: Making dung beetles and connecting them to soil made waste recycling tangible; the detail that dung also shelters their young added interest.

arbitrary.text: The watering place felt somewhat disconnected from the completed food web. Its purpose remained unclear in the results shown.

continue.text: Yes. Building a food web from feeding and recycling relationships was engaging, and I would be curious to see what the world does next, although several later choices were the only offered actions.
